top: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO earlier this month amid reports of affairs. Less than two weeks later, the board brought him back.
comment: Nvidia stock jumped about 30% the day he returned, after Trump publicly pushed for it. Fastest comeback in tech history?
topic_it: Jensen Huang reintegrato CEO di Nvidia (23 nov) meno di due settimane dopo le dimissioni per notizie di relazioni extraconiugali; pressioni di Trump; azioni +30% circa
